title: 1570 Concepción earthquake
summary: The English Wikipedia article "1570 Concepción earthquake", at revision 1382135844, opens: "The 1570 Concepción earthquake occurred at 9:00, on February 8, 1570. The earthquake caused significant damage to the city of Concepción, Chile. A tsunami followed the earthquake afterwards, however the majority of the townsfolk of Concepción were able to escape inland from the tsunami. An estimated 2,000 people died in the event. Aftershocks were felt from the earthquake until 5 months afterwards." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q1109042, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "earthquake in Chile". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
